newsitem.title: USA: Act Teleconferencing sees Q2 revenue up 50 pct.
newsitem.headline: Act Teleconferencing sees Q2 revenue up 50 pct.

text.p: Act Teleconferencing Inc said Tuesday it expects its revenues for the second quarter ended June 30 to show an increase in excess of 50 percent, accompanied by increased profitability.

Act Chairman Gerald Van Eeckhout said the company's core audio teleconferencing operations based in the United States, United Kingdom and continental Europe are all now achieving robust profitability.

He said that in response to the recent rapid rise in the company's share price, a European investment group recently accumulated "a significant number of shares" in the company and had filed a 13D statement on the matter with U.S. regulators.
He did not identify the group. Filing of a 13D statement usually signifies that the filer has acquired a stake of 5.0 percent or more in a publicly traded U.S. company.
For the second quarter of 1996, Act reported a net loss of $202,761 or $0.07 per share, on revenues of $1.56 million.
